excluded.title: MGS TES, Global Dust Index (tes_ruffdust)
excluded.reason: Duplicates tes-dust-cover. No data is painted grey rather than transparent, and shaded relief is baked into the colours, so no-data can't be separated without guessing. The Trek legend endpoint returns HTTP 500, so there are no values.

excluded.title: MRO CRISM, Carbonate Minerals V1 Fe-Mg (frt_07_brcarj_mtr3_ll) and V2 Mg (frt_07_brcr2j_mtr3_ll)
excluded.reason: Not a mosaic. These are CRISM FRT footprints (MapServer feature service mars_mro_crism_mtrdr_c0a_humex_frt_sites) linking per-observation browse images. Coverage is scattered small targets with a qualitative browse colour scheme. Carbonate detections are shipped instead as the 'carbonate' class (36 sites) in aqueous-minerals.

excluded.title: Mars Odyssey GRS element maps in Trek
excluded.reason: Not in Trek: searchItems for GRS, Gamma, Silicon and Hydrogen returned 0 items. Si, H2O and Fe were shipped from PDS instead (grs-silicon, grs-water, grs-iron). K, Th, Cl and K/Th exist in the same PDS volume but were not shipped (not requested).

excluded.title: MGS TES, Global Surface Albedo
excluded.reason: Not on the requested list. No legend (HTTP 500), so it could only ship as qualitative, and tes-dust-cover covers the dust question. Could be added later at 1024x512.

excluded.title: MGS MOLA and Mars Express HRSC, DEM (Mars_MOLA_blend200ppx_HRSC_DEM_clon0dd_200mpp_lzw)
excluded.reason: A numerical DEM already ships from MOLA (mola-elevation). At 4 px/deg the HRSC contribution (200 m) is averaged away, so a second grid would add size for no visible gain.

excluded.title: MRO CRISM Polyhydrated Sulfate Indicator, USGS Mars Chart 18 (MC18_PolySulfate_Mineral_IndicatorV2_SP); Fe-Mg Smectite Indicator, CRISM tile 1303
